interest: Shows the Edwards zaibatsu-dissolution report's distribution, and 1948 scrutiny over releasing the FEC-230 antitrust policy.
keywords: Division of Japanese and Korean Economic Affairs
Division of Occupied Areas Economic Affairs
overview: Docket (1946-48) on Japanese zaibatsu policy: distributing the Edwards combines report to Judge Pierson Hall, and declining to release the still-pending FEC-230 antitrust policy to a private attorney.
